quizzes.title: General Knowledge Quiz
quizzes.description: Test your general knowledge with these interesting questions!

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet because of its reddish appearance caused by iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.

questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.explanation: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci in the early 16th century.

questions.question: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.explanation: 2 is the smallest and only even prime number.

questions.question: In which year did World War II end?
questions.explanation: World War II ended in 1945 with the surrender of Japan in September.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au is the chemical symbol for gold, derived from the Latin word 'aurum'.

questions.question: Which country is home to the kangaroo?
questions.explanation: Kangaroos are native to Australia and are one of its most iconic animals.

questions.question: How many continents are there?
questions.explanation: There are 7 continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, and South America.

questions.question: What is the speed of light?
questions.explanation: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.

questions.question: What is H2O commonly known as?
questions.explanation: H2O is the chemical formula for water, consisting of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouse of the cell because they generate most of the cell's ATP energy.

questions.question: What force keeps us on the ground?
questions.explanation: Gravity is the force that attracts objects toward the center of the Earth.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest naturally occurring substance known.

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human body has 206 bones.
